title: Canonical isomorphisms of infinitesimal admissible-blowup fibres
statement: Let (A,I) be a henselian pair with I finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], let A' be its I-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and let J be a finitely generated ideal with J.radical = I.radical. Put Y = Bl_J(Spec A) and Y' = Bl_(JA')(Spec A') [def-nagata-affine-blowup]. For every n ≥ 1 there is an isomorphism e: Y' ×_(Spec A') Spec(A'/I^n A') ≅ Y ×_(Spec A) Spec(A/I^n) [def-pc-fibre-product]. Its composite with the first projection is the first projection followed by the canonical Rees blowup comparison [def-nagata-strict-transform-blowup-comparison]; its composite with the second projection is the second projection followed by Spec of the canonical quotient map A/I^n → A'/I^n A'.

source.place: XX 2.4.3 and XX 4.4 final Note, printed pp.364 and 374.

proof.text: Regard J as an index using equality of radicals and vanishing loci. Apply the Rees-reduction clause of [lem-per-admissible-modification-system] at m=n. It gives the canonical ring isomorphism on reduced Rees algebras, specified on every polynomial representative. The degreewise congruences also identify each homogeneous summand and preserve multiplication.

Apply arbitrary relative Proj base change [lemma-nagata-relative-proj-base-change-arbitrary] to the two quotient bases and use the graded isomorphism from step 1. This gives the claimed fibre isomorphism. The degree-zero action is the quotient map in the statement. On a standard chart, the homogeneous fraction z/a^d maps to its canonical image; hence the first projection agrees with [def-nagata-strict-transform-blowup-comparison]. Both projection identities follow. The argument includes I=0, nilpotent ideals and empty Proj.

proof_origin.place: XX 2.4.3 and XX 4.4 final Note, printed pp.364 and 374.

lean.statement:
theorem admissibleCompletion_fiber_iso {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [HenselianRing A I] (hI : I.FG)
    (J : Ideal A) (hJ : J.FG) (hJI : J.radical = I.radical)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ e :
      pullback (AffineBlowup.toSpec (J.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I ^ n).map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A)))))) ≅
        pullback (AffineBlowup.toSpec J)
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)))),
      e.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫
        AffineBlowup.hom (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A)) rfl ∧
      e.hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.snd _ _ ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.quotientMap ((I ^ n).map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A)))
            (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A)) Ideal.le_comap_map))
